author: Seung Wook
problem: Read N applicants' math and English scores and X, Y, Z. Accept the X best in math, then the Y best in English among the rest, then the Z best by total among the rest, always breaking ties by the smaller applicant number; print the accepted applicant numbers in ascending order, one per line.
bug_description: Prints the set of accepted numbers in set iteration order instead of sorted, which is out of order once numbers reach the set's table size.

comments.accurate: Admits applicants by math, then English, then total score, and prints their numbers in increasing order
comments.wrong_behavior: Admits applicants by math, then English, then total score, and prints the collected set of numbers
comments.wrong_location: Output order verified; check the tie-breaking by applicant number in the three selection loops
